rule: Finish and verify the scoped task, record remaining installation/live evidence, then take the next independent task. A local pass does not close its workflow chain.

tasks.title: Protect unpaid POS-to-room transfers and prevent subsequent POS collection
tasks.confirmed_problem: Reviewed room-transfer source posts the full bill despite prior POS money, replays by key without proving the requested destination/source, and the terminal still offers POS collection after transfer.
finish_checks: An unpaid sent/served bill posts exactly one original-source folio charge with inclusive tax/service/discount components.
Prior or pending money, routed cash, provider success/uncertainty and active receipt review stop an unallocated transfer.
Retries match original order, folio, property, currency, components and valid saved line; wrong destination/key/source refuses.
New POS receipts, late confirmation and routed cash cannot collect the transferred debt again; non-monetary evidence remains recordable.
Folio/stay ownership and status are checked; all effects roll back on downstream failure; original function owner/grants remain.
Terminal displays POS collection separately from transferred debt and refreshes Finance/folio views. Tests, TypeScript, build and smoke pass.
